metcon.name: Teams of 3
metcon.description:
Teams of 3
For Time
BUY IN: 400m Run together
THEN 4 Rounds
45/36 cal Assault Bike
24 Pull Ups
24 Hand Release Push Ups
150m Carry *
6 Synchro Burpees
THEN
BUY OUT: 400m Run
P1: 2 x 24/16 Farmer Carry
P2: Wall Ball Bear hug Carry
P3: Swap every 50m
RX+ C2B / HSPU / 32/24 KB / Sandbag
Scale Pull Ups to Ring Rows
Scale Push Ups to Elevated Push Ups
Scale KB to 16/12kg

hypertrophy.reasoning: Today heavily taxed pressing, pulling, and anterior chain; target posterior chain and arm hypertrophy without competing for recovery.
